summary.text: Jimmy Gordon is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 28A, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gordon is a business owner and former mayor of Isanti.

paragraphs.text: Jimmy Gordon, listed by Ballotpedia as James Gordon, was born in Cambridge, Minnesota.
His career experience includes owning and operating Jimmy's Pizzas in Isanti, North Branch, and New Town, North Dakota, and serving as a firefighter for the Isanti Fire District.
He previously served as mayor of Isanti and as a member of the city council.
Gordon succeeded Brian Johnson in District 28A.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Human Services Finance and Policy, Education Policy, and Elections Finance and Policy committees.
